failureAnalysis.cause: Root and Git metadata descriptor traversal used O_RDONLY for all ancestors. The deployment state directory is correctly root-owned 0711, allowing search but denying directory reads to the native UID.

failureAnalysis.cause: The client proof assertion compared the {value,operationId} RPC wrapper itself rather than its value. Workspace write and private witness had already succeeded.
failureAnalysis.repair: Unwrap .value for private witness assertions; no product change.
